invariant: A compatible output shape is not evidence that the authoritative capability produced the result.
method: Each retained assessment is classified by shape (tools/evidence/check_assessment_producer.py:looks_native_agent_ready) and by recorded provenance. Surrogate = provider_evidence carries runner-asserted fields (invocation/adapter/model/...) or a claude provider or a bootstrap-assessor disposition. Native = MCP envelope, or exact contract shape with Agent Ready's 4-key codex provider_evidence. PY-01's interface is UNKNOWN: its shape is native and its request lacks surrogate instructions, but no invocation was recorded. Files are not modified; sha256 is recorded so any later change is visible. PG-00 (receipt excerpt) and PG-18 (retained copy missing five required fields) are declared partial_record: a partial record is held to native provenance only (Agent Ready disposition, 4-key codex provider_evidence, no runner-asserted fields) because the full shape is absent by declaration, not by substitution; their producer claims cite the gate documentation.
